summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K reporting that shareholders approved a 1-for-10,000 reverse stock split and authorization to allot up to 25,000,000 new shares. The reverse split takes effect July 30, 2026 and is accompanied by a proportional change in the ADS-to-ordinary share ratio (from 1 ADS per 500,000 shares to 1 ADS per 50 shares). The change does not affect proportional ownership. No price, premium, or advisor is mentioned. The filing also notes adoption of new articles of association. This appears to be a capital structure adjustment without an explicit capital return mechanism; however, extreme reverse splits often signal an effort to maintain listing or facilitate future financing, not a traditional capital return. Confidence is medium because the event is a shareholder-approved structural change, not a direct return of capital.
